bio.text: Joy Powers won the Democratic nomination for Virginia's 9th Congressional District in August 2026 and will face Republican incumbent Rep. Morgan Griffith in the November general election.
The Associated Press describes her as a rancher and business owner from Bedford.
Powers, of Bedford County, ran unsuccessfully for the Virginia House of Delegates' 51st District in November 2025, losing to Republican incumbent Del. Eric Zehr.
